purpose: Why the built-in voice of Drama 3 ran to the 1024-frame cap instead of stopping, and the fix: eos kept in every nucleus plus a serve-side default silence guard. Per-frame evidence in trace-20261121/, protocol arms below.

engine.build: trim-bf16-int3 (14.50 GiB), Mac NVFP4 engine, scripts/build-engine.sh --weights nvfp4

protocol: smaller-builds: 24 texts, salts 0/1, built-in and eq-3ref voices, --max-frames 1024; failed = capped, WER > 0.2 or a quiet run >= 3 s inside speech (Whisper large-v3)

per_frame_evidence.files: trace-20261121/: <take>.rows (prompt rows), <take>.frames (chosen main token and 9 codes per frame), <take>.per-frame.json (eos rank/p/cumulative, top candidate share, each nucleus keeps-eos, drawn main token). Made by trace_eos.py; its analyze mode replays the pre-patch draws and matches 925/1024 frames on medium-05 s0 (the attractor frames wide margins; close speech races expose the replay as an approximation, e.g. 56/208 on medium-04 s0).
per_frame_evidence.tool: drama3-generate with a --logits-out tracer (a scratch edit of generate.zig, not part of the patch); the tables and frames in trace-20261121/ are the committed record
per_frame_evidence.reading: On both medium-05 salts eos is rank 1 at p 2-22 % for ~680 frames from frame ~340, and its cumulative probability sits above both top_p cutoffs (0.9 request, 0.95 RAS), so both truncated draws exclude the stop the model asks for every frame; the take holds quiet to the cap. On the passing takes eos is never excluded above 2 % before the stop.

cause.mechanism: After sentence 1 of medium-05, token 251273 (candidate 3175) carries ~96.6 % of the candidate mass with eos rank 1 at 2-22 %: nucleus truncation removes eos from both main-token draws, a stop the model asks for cannot be drawn, and the take runs to the frame cap.
cause.sentence2_unreachable: From frame ~250 the mass on resuming sentence 2 is under 0.5 %: medium-05 WER 0.68 is model quality, not stopping; no stop rule heals it without inventing speech.

fix: sample.metal draw_top keeps the eos candidate slot in both main-token draws (request top_p 0.9 and RAS top_p 0.95); kernels.zig forwards it and mirrors the keep rule in drawKeeps, forward.zig passes shards.eosCandidate(e.c, e.w.n_cand); code heads pass -1.

drama_host fills an unset silence guard with floor -40 dBFS / 3.5 s: the same collapse trails sub-floor quiet or murmur around a late eos. 3.5 s clears the longest quiet stretch inside any passing take (2.06 s built-in, 1.43 s reference), so a trip never cuts speech a take goes on to speak; --silence-seconds 0 still disables it.

verification.sampler_alone_stops_medium_05: With the patched sampler and no guard (drama3-generate, bare prompt, same seeds), medium-05 draws eos at frames 357 (s0) and 350 (s1) instead of capping: the eos exemption ends the runaway by itself. The committed <take>-after.frames hold those token streams; the three passing takes re-trace prefix-identical and end 1, 43 and 1 frames earlier.
verification.serve_arms_note: Through serve the shipped guard fires first - 3.5 s of sub-floor quiet after the speech - so the protocol arms below record finish=silence for medium-05. Both paths end the take before the cap; the guard is tail hygiene, the exemption the cause fix.

issue_32: Hypothesis, not a traced fact: the full-model tagged-dialogue cap of issue #32 is consistent with this mechanism (a take runs to the cap while the model wants to stop), but no full-model trace was taken on this card. The Metal fix ports to the CUDA sampler (one kept-rule term, one slot argument, one default).
limits: Built-in failed takes stay 4 of 48; what the stop fix could move did move: capped 2 -> 0, medium-05 ends naturally on both salts. The rest is outside stopping: medium-05 both salts and short-01 s0 speak only part of the text (WER 0.68 / 0.71) and long-01 s1 stalls 3.13 s inside speech (quiet-run failure; its audio is byte-identical before and after).
The CUDA nvfp4 sampler (engine/nvfp4/patches) shares the mechanism but is not ported here: no CUDA window on this Mac. The same two changes apply.
